about.headerIntro: Experience and approach to web development, combining a solid technical foundation, functional vision, and continuous improvement.
about.p1: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience in .NET Core, C#, React, Angular, and database management. I work on creating and improving web applications, taking care of both the technical side and functional clarity. I enjoy analyzing, structuring, and building solutions that are stable, useful, and easy to maintain.
about.p2: I come from the telecommunications sector, where I learned to listen, solve problems, and work with discipline. Today, I apply that same mindset to development: constant curiosity, continuous improvement, and a strong commitment to doing things well. My philosophy is simple: motivation, effort, and continuous growth.
